A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that lungs from NHBD rats have increased capillary permeabilty, which can be ameliorated by increasing intracelular cAMP levels.
the use of a phosphodiesteras inhibitor and a beta-adrenergic agonist can attenuate capillary leakage in lungs retrieved from a non-heart-beating rat model.
the combination of isoproterenols and roliprams may be a potential therapy to attenuate the capillary permeability in lungs retrieved from donors after cardiac death.
